_meta.description: Machine-generated, honest per-site narrative profiles for every real FAO-selected final-location site currently in this deployment catalog (D45/D48), one profile per site, two -999 sentinel sites excluded (D10/D45). Each entry carries both the full plain narrative document ("narrative", English, D39) and its already-encoded, round-trip-verified #narrative= link ("link") -- use the link directly, or read/translate "narrative" if you need the plain source (e.g. Staff producing a translated copy, D39/D42). Generated 2026-09-05 from data/site-scores.json via a template (DECISIONS.md D48): no discovery, no surprise required -- every field traces directly to a real gdallocationinfo reading.

schema.country: ISO3-ish lowercase code: cod (DR Congo), caf (Central African Republic), civ (Cote d'Ivoire)
schema.commodity: lowercase commodity/theme key, matches the hih-<country>-<commodity>-score/-final source_id pattern
schema.site_index: index into that country/commodity's live -final.geojson feature array (data/site-scores.json)
schema.rank: 1 = highest Hand-in-Hand score among this commodity/country's real sites, site_count = lowest
schema.site_count: total real (non-sentinel) sites for this commodity/country
schema.aez33_class: real GAEZ AEZ33 classification code at this site, gdallocationinfo-verified
schema.lon: longitude (bbox-center approximation of the real final-location polygon)
schema.title: the narrative document's own title, English (D39 -- this Library stays English-only; Staff translates live)
schema.narrative: the full plain narrative_version/title/steps document -- read this if you need the source (e.g. to translate)
schema.link: a ready-to-use https://dwg7.github.io/ferspas57/#narrative=... URL, already encoding "narrative" -- open directly for the English version

_meta.usage: For Staff (STAFF-PROMPT.md Narrative Mode): find entries matching the user's country/commodity (and, if code execution is available, fetch this file directly rather than relying on it being pre-loaded in context -- see D48). For a tool-less Staff, this index is too large to embed in the system prompt; rely on NARRATIVES.md's small curated set instead, or say plainly that a specific per-site profile is not something you can look up without a tool.
